_comment: MCP servers useful for embedded work. Copy the entries you want into your harness config: .mcp.json (Claude Code, project scope), ~/.codex/config.toml [mcp_servers] (Codex), .cursor/mcp.json (Cursor). Nothing here is enabled by default — review each before adding.

context7._why: Up-to-date library/framework docs instead of training data. Useful for Zephyr, ESP-IDF, kernel APIs that move between releases.

filesystem._why: Scoped filesystem access for reference material kept outside the repo: datasheets, schematics exports, BSP release notes.

git._why: Repository history and blame across a multi-repo BSP workspace.

fetch._why: Reading vendor documentation, errata sheets and mailing list threads.

serial-bridge._why: OPTIONAL and high-risk: exposes a serial console to the agent. Only enable on a dedicated development board with a known recovery path. Never on a production or customer unit.
